question: Evaluate: (-9) - (-60) ÷ (-10) + (- 4) × 7
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the BODMAS rule directly left to right based on priority.

⇒ (−9) − [−60 ÷ −10] + [−4 × 7]

⇒ −9 − 6 − 28

⇒ −15 − 28 = −43

**∴ The correct answer is −43.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(−9) − (−60) ÷ (−10) + (−4) × 7

**Concept Used:**

BODMAS Rule dictates the order of mathematical operations: Brackets, Orders, Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

**Calculations:**

⇒ According to the BODMAS rule, perform the division operation first:

⇒ (−60) ÷ (−10) = 6

⇒ Substitute this value back into the expression:

⇒ (−9) − 6 + (−4) × 7

⇒ Next, perform the multiplication operation:

⇒ (−4) × 7 = −28

⇒ Substitute this value back into the expression:

⇒ −9 − 6 − 28

⇒ Finally, perform addition and subtraction from left to right:

⇒ −15 − 28 = −43

**∴ The correct answer is −43.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

It establishes the order of calculations: Brackets, Orders (powers and roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction. Division and Multiplication share the same priority (solved left to right), as do Addition and Subtraction.

Sign Rules for Multiplication and Division

When multiplying or dividing two numbers: if the signs are identical (both positive or both negative), the resultant value is positive. If the signs are different, the resultant value is negative.
